targets: Baseline measurement before any gauntlet-driven improvement

criteria.label: Match engine unit/acceptance tests pass
Every simulated match ends in a valid, rule-conformant finish
Worst match type time-limit draw rate (lower is better)
criteria.evidence: time-limit draws should be rare outside iron man

criteria.label: Finishers used per singles match (target ~1)
Mirror-match side balance (no first-side bias)
Finish-type variety in singles (distinct finishes)
Match-type coverage vs target list (singles, tag, sub, no-DQ, last man, iron man, ladder, cage, hell cell, rumble, chamber, triple threat)
Match rating spread (std of stars; shows quality varies with play)
Average singles match length (minutes, target 7-14)
Featured action options per decision within 6-12
Defender options per defence decision >= 6
Player decisions per singles match
Smart play beats random play in matches (win share)
Career win-rate: smart vs weak vs random strategies ordered with clear gaps
Scenario choices carry real consequences (templates with >=2 weighted outcomes & distinct effects)
Pre/post-match decisions available (plan, entrance, stipulation, post-match action, promo)
Memory tests pass
Career audits: ledger chain, world replay equals live state, no double counting
Share of scenario templates that read ledger memory (mem trigger / memory block / rivalry / obligation)
Long-horizon retrievability: ledger events retained and verifiable after 3 simulated years
Scenarios actually recalling prior events in play (share of resolved scenarios with recalled memory)
criteria.evidence: ledger scenario events with recalled refs
